title: Oracle Fusion Consultant
summary: Support Oracle Cloud delivery across ERP, HCM, SCM, EPM or CX workstreams for enterprise transformation programmes.
responsibilities: Translate business requirements into Oracle Cloud solution designs.
Support configuration, testing, migration and user enablement.
Work with integration, reporting and managed services teams after go-live.
requirements: Oracle Fusion implementation or support experience.
Strong process knowledge in at least one functional domain.
Clear communication with business and technical stakeholders.

title: NetSuite ERP Consultant
summary: Help growing organisations implement, optimise and support NetSuite ERP, finance, inventory and reporting capabilities.
responsibilities: Gather requirements and map them to NetSuite processes.
Support configuration, workflows, reporting and user acceptance testing.
Contribute to post-go-live optimisation and managed support.
requirements: NetSuite ERP delivery or support experience.
Understanding of finance, operations or supply-chain processes.
Ability to document decisions and support client workshops.

title: Salesforce Consultant
summary: Design and deliver Salesforce capabilities that improve sales, service, customer operations and workflow visibility.
responsibilities: Support discovery, process mapping and Salesforce solution design.
Configure CRM workflows, reports, automations and integrations.
Work with delivery teams to improve adoption and platform value.
requirements: Salesforce implementation, administration or consulting experience.
Knowledge of Sales Cloud, Service Cloud or platform automation.
Strong problem-solving and stakeholder communication skills.

title: Integration Engineer
summary: Build secure integration patterns across enterprise platforms, APIs, data services and operational systems.
responsibilities: Design and implement APIs, data flows and reusable integration services.
Work with enterprise application, data and infrastructure teams.
Support integration testing, monitoring, troubleshooting and documentation.
requirements: Experience with integration platforms, APIs or middleware.
Understanding of data exchange patterns, security and observability.
Comfort working across business and technical teams.

title: Data & Analytics Consultant
summary: Help organisations improve visibility through reporting, analytics, governed data and AI-ready foundations.
responsibilities: Build dashboards, reports and data models for decision support.
Support data quality, governance and source-system understanding.
Work with stakeholders to turn business questions into measurable insights.
requirements: Experience with analytics, BI, reporting or data platforms.
Ability to analyse data requirements and communicate findings.
Knowledge of Tableau, Oracle Analytics, SQL or related tools is useful.

title: Managed Services Engineer
summary: Keep critical platforms stable, secure and continuously improved through managed operations and support.
responsibilities: Monitor and support enterprise applications, cloud services or integrations.
Handle incidents, service requests, documentation and improvement actions.
Work with delivery teams to transition projects into reliable operations.
requirements: Experience in application, infrastructure or platform support.
Understanding of service management, troubleshooting and escalation.
Strong ownership, communication and documentation habits.
